takes.situation: She takes the Fixer for the Bureau and jokes, and the joke dies on the threat. For Aster: written to the sheet (a few minutes, she never tells him), but §07 [c2f50e911d9850c901298a11] has a pressured Inez tell him, door 1:40; please resolve.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Bureau again? Tell them I died. They can stamp that.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not the Bureau. That terrace must be cruel on your feet.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Then sit or go. Milena thinks I'm idling as it is.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Quietly. The Office hears about you and Okafor unless you oblige me.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who's seen? Has it gone down a tube already? Oblige how?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: When I telephone, call Okafor over, a few minutes off his door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'll tell him I've news, not for the line. He'll believe me.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I know he will. Sit down somewhere, when your shift lets you.

learned: Inez knows the Fixer's face now.

takes.situation: She says yes before she knows to what, and the Fixer slows her down and makes her hear what she agreed to.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Selling? The Bureau stamps my card before I'm paid. Try next door.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not selling. I'd hate the Office to hear about you and Okafor.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Yes. Whatever it is, yes. Did anyone see you come over?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Softly. Yes to what? And when do they let you rest?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: They don't. Tell me, quick. Nobody's on my tables.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I'll telephone. You bring Okafor over. His door's empty a few minutes.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: So I lie to him. I'll say it can't go by telephone.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Then the Office hears nothing. If you don't call, it hears everything.

takes.situation: The Fixer opens on Okafor as friendly gossip; her fondness gives her away, and the same fondness is what the lie will spend.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Okafor stops here every day before his shift. It isn't the coffee.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: It's terrible coffee. He drinks it and makes that face, every day.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: You've earned it, those shifts. The Office could hear about you two.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who said two? Was it Milena? Who's watching my terrace?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Keep it low. One stamped form tells them, unless you oblige us.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Anything. If it's money, ask the Bureau, they've got mine.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I'll telephone. You call Okafor over, a few minutes off his door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'll say it can't wait, not on the line. He'll be pleased.

learned: She could describe the Fixer's face.
